$comment: Curated tier manifest for the Ultravioleta bazaar. Loaded at runtime (fail-open) via BAZAAR_CURATION_PATH (default config/bazaar_curation.json). Matching is host-exact + path-boundary on the PARSED URL (discovery_security::match_manifest_prefix), NEVER a raw string prefix. Tiers order the listing: first_party > vip > verified > listed. Every URL/payTo below is live-verified evidence (see docs/plans/bazaar/01 SS6). Do not add entries from memory.

entries.name: describe.net
entries.$evidence: live 402 probes 2026-09-10, all six accepts on every paid route and one payTo: /reputation/wallet/{w} (10000), /reputation/wallet/{w}/history (30000), /reputation/rater/{r} (10000), /reputation/agent/{chain}/{id} (20000) and /leaderboard/page (10000), each 402 with eip155:8453, 43114, 42161, 10, 137, 42220 and payTo 0xe4dc963c56979E0260fc146b87eE24F18220e545. The free routes are excluded on purpose and measured as such: GET /leaderboard and GET /health answered 200, and the manifest path /leaderboard/page cannot match them. POST /mcp answered 200 to initialize (serverInfo describe.net 2.0.0) and listed 14 tools; it is free at the door and its paid tools relay the 402 of their own route. That payTo is the SAME address MeshRelay lists above -- the owner's shared collection wallet, not a copy-paste error; MeshRelay could not be re-probed the same day because GET /channels answered {"total":0} and its /payments/access/ paths 404. No erc8004 field: describe.net's agent card (GET /.well-known/agent-card.json, 200 on both describe.net and api.describe.net) declares no registration, agentId or registry, and the payTo wallet holds 12 identities shared across products (9 Base + 3 Avalanche per its own GET /wallets/{payTo}/chains), so none can be attributed to describe.net from the outside. That describe.net settles through THIS facilitator is the one claim here not verified from outside: its brief cites describe-net/describenet/paywall.py:84 and mcp_server.py:129 pinning FACILITATOR_URL=https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz, and that repo is not checked out here; its public surface (402 body, /openapi.json, /skill.md) never names a facilitator, and the last 200 rows of our own GET /transactions carry no payTo of ours to match -- which proves nothing either way, that index being a fire-and-forget sample rather than a ledger. GET /discovery/resources held no describe.net URL on 2026-09-10; the tier applies once the resources are registered.
